title: The Foundations of Public Health in Kinesiology
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in KNES287; and minimum grade of C- in SPHL100.
Restriction: Must be in a major within the SPHL-Kinesiology department; and must have earned a minimum of 90 credits.
Credit only granted for: KNES340 or KNES400.
Formerly: KNES400.
